pages.text: $(bold)Construction Technique$(): build something from nothing with cursed energy — turning the imaginary real.$(br2)$(bold)Forward (Technique Key C)$(): toggles "Infinite Ammunition Mode" — while holding a weapon that draws ammunition from your inventory (vanilla bows/crossbows, Tinkers' bows and crossbows, TACZ firearms, and so on), when your ammo runs out it spends cursed energy to conjure the matching arrows / bullets on the spot, so you no longer need to stockpile ammunition.$(br2)$(bold)Reversal (Reversal Key F)$(): opens the Conjuration Inventory — pick any item that has a crafting recipe, and its cost, converted from how precious and powerful it is, is deducted as cursed energy immediately; then conjuring begins:$(li)1 cursed energy = 1 tick of construction time$(li)movement speed is halved while conjuring$(li)the reversal cannot be used again while conjuring$(li)being hit interrupts the conjuration, with no cursed energy refunded$(li)when finished, you receive a temporary item that lasts only 60 seconds
